title: Feature negotiation
description: Advertised protocol features keyed by name to a level string. Peers MUST tolerate unknown features. The iw.gpu-memory family (specs/46) pairs each feature below with the iw.<name>/<major> capability it names on the link and HTTP surfaces; the pairing is frozen in contracts/protocol-v1/gpu-memory-capabilities.json.

runtime_families.description: Level "1" negotiates typed runtime families and family-bound native requests (specs/48-49).

runtime_lifecycle.description: Level "1" negotiates isolated lifecycle adapters, immutable-key single-flight loading and transactional swap (specs/50).

runtime_reservations.description: Level "1" negotiates contractVersion 1 runtime resource reservations with fencing and progress-based expiry (specs/50).

transactional_caches.description: Level "1" negotiates the three verified, atomically published cache classes (specs/50).

native_link_requests.description: Level "1" names capability iw.link-native-request/1. It permits bounded typed native dispatch only after the exact current registration and exact Link incarnation complete the native Link v1 Hello/ack binding (specs/45 and specs/49); node-id-wide inference is forbidden.
